blend: factored: P(win)=sum_k a_k*P_k(win); size mix=sum_k b_k*mix_k; a and b are separate simplex vectors over the candidate's members; weights global (not per condition)
weight_fit: minimise squared error against the validation TRUE probabilities on the training folds only (SLSQP, equal-condition not applied), evaluated on the reserved fold
cross_validation: 4 folds grouped by episode, stratified by condition (6 episodes per condition per fold), repeated with 5 different shuffles (seeds 0-4)
primary_metric: out-of-fold contest points: concatenate the 4 reserved folds into one 96-episode prediction set, score with tdx.score.score, average over the 5 repeats
decision_rule: A candidate replaces F only if (mean out-of-fold points gain over F) >= 0.2 AND the paired episode-bootstrap 95% interval (2000 resamples, stratified by condition) of that gain excludes 0. Otherwise keep F. Only A vs B (same seeds) isolates the size x2 loss; any other difference also contains seed-set noise (a 12-member ensemble moves about +-0.3 with the seed set).
forbidden: using any score on the 96 validation episodes to choose members or seeds
note: Addendum 2: moegate counts as useful only if it beats K_control_extra_gru (one more GRU ensemble, same number of members) with an interval excluding 0 and a gain >= 0.2; K=4 vs K=3 is the J-I pair. Seeds are fixed: 41-48 for both (a subset of the frozen GRU seeds 41-52). No candidate may be added after seeing scores. Same folds, metric and rule as frozen_candidates.json.
